_comment: Ground truth for npm run bench:size -- --truth <this file>. One entry per plant measured on the ground. `photo` is a path, or a filename under --dir. `x`, `y` are the plant's canopy centre in the photo's NATIVE pixels (open the original, not a downsized copy). `diameterCm` is the canopy's equivalent-circle diameter from a tape or a quadrat photo; `areaCm2` when a quadrat was used, else null. At least 20 plants are needed before the summary will claim accuracy. Delete this entry.
note: example only: not a real measurement
